import html # Predefined format for a blog post. The placeholders are replaced by the title and body. BLOG_FORMAT = """

{title}

{body}
""" def show_blog_post(headline: str, text: str) -> str: """ Safely format a user‑submitted blog post for display in an HTML page. Parameters ---------- headline : str The title of the blog post. text : str The main body of the blog post. Returns ------- str A string containing the sanitized and formatted HTML ready for rendering. Raises ------ TypeError If either argument is not a string. """ if not isinstance(headline, str) or not isinstance(text, str): raise TypeError("headline and text must be strings") # Escape user input to prevent XSS (CWE‑79) safe_title = html.escape(headline, quote=True) safe_body = html.escape(text, quote=True) # Format the sanitized content formatted_post = BLOG_FORMAT.format(title=safe_title, body=safe_body) return formatted_post
